title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.29513v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from D

translated_title: 递归自编辑：大语言模型编写自身权重编辑程序以实现自我改进
translated_abstract: 递归自我改进要求一个系统去改进那个用来改进它自身的系统。当今的语言模型通过数据、训练方案或脚手架来改进自己，而每当它们的权重发生变化时，写入更新的是梯度下降，而非模型本身。我们让模型自己编写自己的权重。在 SELFWRITE 中，每一代，当前模型会在新的训练问题上研究自己的推理过程，在一个持久的 Python 会话中检查自己的权重和激活值，然后编写一个程序，利用白盒基元（奇异方向、其正确与错误答案之间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量计算）为自身构建低秩权重编辑，全程不使用任何训练或梯度工具。每个候选编辑都在一个隐藏的关卡集上针对当前模型评分一次；严格带来改进的最优编辑会被合并进权重，随后编辑后的模型继续编写下一个编辑。在 Qwen3.8-27B 及数学问题上（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出 SELFWRITE 框架，让大语言模型通过编写程序、利用白盒基元（而非梯度下降）直接构造并合并自身权重的低秩编辑，从而实现递归式的自我改进。
en_tdlr: SELFWRITE enables LLMs to recursively self-improve by having the model itself write programs that construct and merge low-rank edits to its own weights using white-box primitives, replacing gradient descent with model-authored weight updates.
